about.title: Hidden Hills Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Hidden Hills is one of the smallest communities in Los Angeles County, home to roughly 1,924 people behind its gates. Public records for 2025 show no injury collisions and no traffic deaths within city limits, and its busiest stretches, Jed Smith Road, El Dorado Meadow Road and Lewis And Clark Road, see collision counts that would barely register in a larger city. That quiet is real, but it does not shield residents from loss elsewhere. Families here lose loved ones on commutes outside the gates, in hospitals, at job sites, and in facilities meant to care for aging parents. Under California law, a wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. It runs on its own track, entirely apart from any criminal prosecution. The clock is short: generally two years from the date of death, and shorter still when a government entity is involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect Hidden Hills families with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Hidden Hills Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who may file
items.desc: California limits standing to the surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out quickly who in your family has the right to bring the claim.

items.title: Respect for a short deadline
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and claims involving a public agency have an even tighter window. Getting connected early protects your options.

items.title: A full picture of what can be recovered
items.desc: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. None of this depends on whether a criminal case is ever filed.

items.question: Our loved one died outside Hidden Hills. Does that matter for a claim?
items.answer: Not in the way many families worry about. Hidden Hills recorded zero traffic deaths in 2025, so most losses affecting residents happen elsewhere in Los Angeles County or beyond. Where you live does not limit your right to bring a California wrongful death claim; what matters is where and how the death occurred and who was responsible.

items.question: Is a wrongful death case the same as the criminal case?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family, separate from anything a prosecutor decides to do. You can pursue it whether or not criminal charges are filed, and the outcome of one does not control the other.

items.question: What does it cost to get connected through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm, and the independent attorneys we connect you with work on contingency. That means no attorney fee unless there is a recovery in your case.
